IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Committee on Commerce & Labor (originally sponsored by Representatives Conway and Wood)

Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning liability to the department of labor and industries for premiums, overpayments, and penalties.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to liability to the department of labor andindustries for premiums, overpayments, and penalties; and creating anew section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that reducingfraudulent activity by employers, workers, providers, and other personsis a necessary part of achieving excellence in the programsadministered by the department of labor and industries. Thelegislature intends to enhance the authority of the department toaddress issues involving liability to the department for unpaidpremiums, overpayments, and penalties.
